# Bluetooth Finder
> Bluetooth finder app for iPhone: find lost AirPods, earbuds, earphones, headphones and speakers by following their live signal. Hot–cold guidance, no setup. Free download.
## Main sections
- [Home](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/): Bluetooth device finder app — landing, features, and download
- [Guides](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/): Step-by-step guides for finding lost AirPods, earbuds, headphones, smartwatches and speakers
- [FAQ](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/#faq): Questions about the app, accuracy, and supported devices
- [Localized pages](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/): Hreflang landing pages for supported markets
## Guides
- [How to Find Lost AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/how-to-find-lost-airpods/): Lost your AirPods? Use Find My for the map location, then track the live Bluetooth signal to pinpoint them. Step-by-step guide that works even without Find My.
- [Find AirPods Without Find My](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/find-airpods-without-find-my/): No Find My, no iCloud, secondhand AirPods? You can still find them: AirPods broadcast Bluetooth while powered on. Track the signal with an iPhone — here's how.
- [Find One Lost AirPod](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/find-one-lost-airpod/): One AirPod missing? Each earbud broadcasts its own Bluetooth signal while charged. Track it with your iPhone using hot–cold signal guidance — step-by-step guide.
- [Find Dead AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/find-dead-airpods/): Dead AirPods stop broadcasting, so no app can track them live. Here's how to tell if your AirPods are dead, use Find My's last location, and catch them the moment they get any charge.
- [Find Lost Bluetooth Headphones](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/find-lost-bluetooth-headphones/): Lost Bose, Sony, Beats or JBL headphones? If they're on, follow their Bluetooth signal with your iPhone. If they're turned off, here's how to narrow the search and catch them when they wake.
- [Find Lost Earbuds](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/find-lost-earbuds/): Lost wireless earbuds of any brand? While they're out of the case and powered on, they broadcast Bluetooth. Track the signal with your iPhone — here's the full method.
- [Find Lost Smartwatch](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/find-lost-smartwatch/): Fitbit, Garmin, Amazfit and most fitness trackers can't play a sound or show a map. Track their Bluetooth signal with your iPhone instead — a step-by-step guide.
- [Find Lost Bluetooth Speaker](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/find-lost-bluetooth-speaker/): Yes — if your JBL, Bose or Anker speaker is powered on and within ~30 m, you can track its Bluetooth signal with your iPhone and walk straight to it. Here's how, plus what to do if it's off.
- [Bluetooth Scanner for iPhone](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/bluetooth-scanner-iphone/): iPhone Settings only shows paired devices. A Bluetooth scanner app reveals every device around you with signal strength, manufacturer and model — here's how to use one.
- [Find Lost AirPods Case](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/guides/find-lost-airpods-case/): A closed AirPods case with buds inside doesn't broadcast Bluetooth. Here's when a lost case IS findable, how to search for it, and how Find My handles cases by model.
## Guías (es)
- [Guías](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/): Guías paso a paso para encontrar AirPods, auriculares, relojes inteligentes y altavoces perdidos con tu iPhone, incluidos los dispositivos que no están en Buscar.
- [Cómo encontrar AirPods perdidos](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/como-encontrar-airpods-perdidos/): ¿Has perdido tus AirPods? Usa Buscar para ver la ubicación en el mapa y sigue su señal Bluetooth en directo para dar con ellos. Guía paso a paso que funciona incluso sin Buscar.
- [Encontrar AirPods sin Buscar](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/encontrar-airpods-sin-buscar/): ¿Sin Buscar, sin iCloud o AirPods de segunda mano? Aún puedes encontrarlos: los AirPods emiten Bluetooth mientras están encendidos. Rastrea la señal con tu iPhone. Te explicamos cómo.
- [Encontrar un AirPod perdido](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/encontrar-un-airpod-perdido/): ¿Te falta un AirPod? Cada auricular emite su propia señal Bluetooth mientras tiene batería. Rastréalo con tu iPhone con la guía de frío y calor. Guía paso a paso.
- [Encontrar AirPods sin batería](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/encontrar-airpods-sin-bateria/): Los AirPods sin batería no emiten señal. Aprende a saber si están descargados, usa la última ubicación de Buscar y detéctalos en cuanto recuperen carga.
- [Encontrar auriculares Bluetooth perdidos](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/encontrar-auriculares-bluetooth-perdidos/): ¿Has perdido tus auriculares (audífonos) Bose, Sony, Beats o JBL? Si están encendidos, sigue su señal Bluetooth con el iPhone. Si están apagados, te explicamos cómo acotar la búsqueda.
- [Encontrar auriculares inalámbricos perdidos](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/encontrar-auriculares-inalambricos-perdidos/): ¿Perdiste tus auriculares inalámbricos, sean de la marca que sean? Fuera del estuche y encendidos emiten Bluetooth: rastrea su señal con tu iPhone.
- [Encontrar reloj inteligente perdido](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/encontrar-reloj-inteligente-perdido/): Fitbit, Garmin, Xiaomi Band y la mayoría de pulseras no pueden reproducir un sonido ni mostrar un mapa. Rastrea su señal Bluetooth con tu iPhone. Guía paso a paso.
- [Encontrar altavoz Bluetooth perdido](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/encontrar-altavoz-bluetooth-perdido/): Sí: si tu altavoz (bocina o parlante) JBL, Bose o Anker está encendido y a unos 30 m, sigue su señal Bluetooth con tu iPhone. Y qué hacer si está apagado.
- [Escáner Bluetooth para iPhone](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/escaner-bluetooth-iphone/): Ajustes del iPhone solo muestra lo emparejado. Un escáner Bluetooth revela todos los dispositivos cercanos con su señal, fabricante y modelo.
- [Encontrar estuche de AirPods perdido](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/es/guias/encontrar-estuche-airpods-perdido/): Un estuche de AirPods cerrado no emite Bluetooth. Descubre cuándo SÍ se puede encontrar, cómo buscarlo y qué estuches son compatibles con Buscar.
## Ratgeber (de)
- [Ratgeber](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/): Schritt-für-Schritt-Ratgeber, um verlorene AirPods, Bluetooth-Kopfhörer, Smartwatches und Lautsprecher mit dem iPhone zu finden – auch Geräte, die nicht in „Wo ist?“ sind.
- [AirPods finden](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/airpods-finden/): AirPods verloren? So findest du sie: Standort in „Wo ist?“ prüfen und dem Live-Bluetooth-Signal bis in Griffweite folgen – auch ganz ohne „Wo ist?“.
- [AirPods finden ohne „Wo ist?“](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/airpods-finden-ohne-wo-ist/): AirPods nicht in „Wo ist?“, gebraucht gekauft oder kein iCloud-Zugang? So ortest du sie trotzdem über ihr Bluetooth-Signal – Schritt für Schritt mit dem iPhone.
- [Einzelnen AirPod finden](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/einzelnen-airpod-finden/): Nur einen AirPod verloren (links oder rechts)? Jeder Ohrhörer sendet sein eigenes Bluetooth-Signal. So findest du ihn mit Ton und Heiß-Kalt-Anzeige – auch im Sofa.
- [Ausgeschaltete Kopfhörer finden](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/ausgeschaltete-kopfhoerer-finden/): Bluetooth-Gerät ausgeschaltet oder AirPods-Akku leer? Was dann wirklich hilft: letzter Standort, Rest-Akku, gezieltes Absuchen – und Vorsorge fürs nächste Mal.
- [Verlorene Bluetooth-Kopfhörer finden](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/bluetooth-kopfhoerer-finden/): Kann man Bluetooth-Kopfhörer orten? Ja: Sony, Bose, JBL & Beats senden eingeschaltet ein Signal. So findest du verlorene Kopfhörer mit dem iPhone wieder.
- [Kabellose In-Ear-Kopfhörer finden](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/in-ear-kopfhoerer-finden/): In-Ear-Kopfhörer verloren? Galaxy Buds, Xiaomi, JBL, Jabra oder Soundcore findest du mit dem iPhone über ihr Bluetooth-Signal – ohne Hersteller-App und ohne Konto.
- [Smartwatch oder Fitnessarmband finden](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/smartwatch-finden/): Fitbit, Garmin, Xiaomi Band oder Apple Watch verlegt? Smartwatches senden fast ständig Bluetooth. So findest du deine Uhr in Wohnung oder Sporttasche mit dem iPhone.
- [Bluetooth-Lautsprecher finden](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/bluetooth-lautsprecher-finden/): Kann man eine JBL Box orten? Ja, solange sie eingeschaltet ist. So findest du einen verlorenen Bluetooth-Lautsprecher (JBL, Bose, Anker, Sony) mit dem iPhone.
- [Bluetooth-Geräte in der Nähe finden](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/bluetooth-geraete-in-der-naehe-finden/): Das iPhone zeigt nicht alle Bluetooth-Geräte. Mit einem Bluetooth-Scanner siehst du jedes Gerät in der Nähe mit Signalstärke, Hersteller und Modell.
- [AirPods Case finden](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/de/ratgeber/airpods-case-finden/): AirPods Case verloren, mit oder ohne AirPods darin? Die ehrliche Antwort: wann du das Ladecase orten kannst (AirPods Pro 2, Deckel offen) und wie du es sonst findest.
## Guides (fr)
- [Guides](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/): Guides pas à pas pour retrouver AirPods, écouteurs, casque, montre connectée ou enceinte perdus avec l'iPhone – même hors de « Localiser ».
- [Retrouver des AirPods perdus](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/retrouver-airpods-perdus/): AirPods perdus ? Vérifiez leur position dans « Localiser », puis suivez leur signal Bluetooth en direct jusqu'à portée de main – même sans « Localiser ».
- [Retrouver des AirPods sans « Localiser »](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/retrouver-airpods-sans-localiser/): AirPods absents de « Localiser », d'occasion ou sans iCloud ? Retrouvez-les en suivant leur signal Bluetooth avec l'iPhone. Méthode pas à pas.
- [Retrouver un seul AirPod](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/retrouver-un-airpod-perdu/): Un seul AirPod perdu ? Chaque écouteur émet son propre signal Bluetooth. Faites-le sonner avec « Localiser » ou suivez son signal avec l'iPhone.
- [Retrouver des écouteurs éteints](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/retrouver-ecouteurs-eteints/): AirPods déchargés ou écouteurs éteints ? Ce qui marche vraiment : dernière position connue, scans réguliers et recherche ciblée. La réponse honnête.
- [Retrouver un casque Bluetooth](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/retrouver-casque-bluetooth-perdu/): Casque ou écouteurs Bluetooth perdus ? Sony, Bose, JBL ne sont pas dans « Localiser ». Suivez leur signal Bluetooth avec l'iPhone jusqu'à les retrouver.
- [Retrouver des écouteurs sans fil](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/retrouver-ecouteurs-sans-fil-perdus/): Écouteurs sans fil perdus ? Galaxy Buds, Xiaomi, JBL, JVC ou Jabra : une seule méthode les retrouve tous depuis l'iPhone, sans l'app du fabricant.
- [Retrouver une montre connectée](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/retrouver-montre-connectee-perdue/): Montre connectée ou bracelet d'activité perdu ? Fitbit, Garmin, Xiaomi Band ou Apple Watch émettent en Bluetooth : retrouvez-les avec l'iPhone.
- [Retrouver une enceinte Bluetooth](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/retrouver-enceinte-bluetooth-perdue/): Peut-on localiser une enceinte JBL, Bose ou Sony perdue ? Oui, tant qu'elle est allumée et à portée : suivez son signal Bluetooth avec l'iPhone.
- [Détecter les appareils Bluetooth à proximité](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/detecter-appareils-bluetooth-a-proximite/): Voyez tous les appareils Bluetooth autour de vous sur iPhone : nom, fabricant, modèle et intensité du signal. Retrouvez ou identifiez un appareil.
- [Retrouver un boîtier AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/fr/guides/retrouver-boitier-airpods-perdu/): Boîtier AirPods perdu, avec ou sans écouteurs ? Quand on peut le localiser (AirPods Pro 2, couvercle ouvert), quand on ne peut pas, et que faire.
## Guide (it)
- [Guide](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/): Guide passo passo per ritrovare AirPods, auricolari, cuffie, smartwatch o casse Bluetooth persi con l'iPhone – anche senza Dov'è.
- [Ritrovare gli AirPods persi](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/come-ritrovare-airpods-persi/): AirPods persi? Controlla la posizione in Dov'è, poi segui il loro segnale Bluetooth in tempo reale fino a trovarli – anche senza Dov'è.
- [Trovare gli AirPods senza Dov'è](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/trovare-airpods-senza-dov-e/): AirPods non presenti in Dov'è, usati o senza iCloud? Ritrovali seguendo il loro segnale Bluetooth con l'iPhone. Metodo passo passo.
- [Trovare un solo AirPod](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/trovare-un-airpod-perso/): Hai perso un solo AirPod? Ogni auricolare trasmette il proprio segnale Bluetooth. Fallo suonare con Dov'è o segui il suo segnale con l'iPhone.
- [Trovare AirPods scarichi](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/trovare-airpods-scarichi/): AirPods scarichi o cuffie spente? Cosa funziona davvero: ultima posizione nota, scansioni regolari e ricerca mirata. La risposta onesta.
- [Trovare cuffie Bluetooth perse](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/trovare-cuffie-bluetooth-perse/): Cuffie Bluetooth perse in casa? Sony, Bose e JBL non sono in Dov'è. Segui il loro segnale Bluetooth con l'iPhone e ritrovale in pochi minuti.
- [Trovare auricolari wireless persi](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/trovare-auricolari-wireless-persi/): Auricolari wireless persi? Galaxy Buds, Xiaomi, JBL, Soundcore o Jabra: un solo metodo li ritrova tutti dall'iPhone, senza l'app del produttore.
- [Trovare uno smartwatch perso](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/trovare-smartwatch-perso/): Smartwatch o fitness tracker perso? Fitbit, Garmin, Xiaomi Smart Band o Apple Watch trasmettono in Bluetooth: ritrovali con l'iPhone.
- [Trovare una cassa Bluetooth](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/trovare-cassa-bluetooth-persa/): Si può localizzare una cassa JBL, Bose o Sony persa? Sì, finché è accesa e nel raggio d'azione: segui il suo segnale Bluetooth con l'iPhone.
- [Trovare dispositivi Bluetooth vicini](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/trovare-dispositivi-bluetooth-vicini/): Come cercare un dispositivo Bluetooth con l'iPhone: vedi tutti i dispositivi vicini con nome, produttore, modello e intensità del segnale.
- [Trovare la custodia degli AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/it/guide/trovare-custodia-airpods-persa/): Custodia degli AirPods persa, con o senza auricolari? Quando si può localizzare (AirPods Pro 2, coperchio aperto), quando no, e cosa fare.
## ガイド (jp)
- [ガイド](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/): なくしたAirPods、ワイヤレスイヤホン（片方だけも）、ヘッドホン、スマートウォッチ、Bluetoothスピーカーの探し方を状況別に解説。「探す」がなくてもiPhoneで探せます。
- [なくしたAirPodsの探し方](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/how-to-find-lost-airpods/): AirPodsが見つからない時は、まず「探す」でサウンドを再生。地図が大まかすぎる・登録していない場合は、iPhoneでBluetooth信号をたどって手の届く距離まで探せます。
- [「探す」なしでAirPodsを探す](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/find-airpods-without-find-my/): AirPodsが「探す」に表示されない、登録していない、中古で前の持ち主のまま。それでもケースの外にあれば、iPhoneでBluetooth信号をたどって探せます。
- [AirPodsを片方なくしたとき](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/find-one-lost-airpod/): AirPodsを片方だけなくした？左右のイヤホンはそれぞれBluetooth信号を出しています。「探す」で片方だけ鳴らすか、iPhoneで信号をたどって見つけましょう。
- [電池切れのAirPodsを探す](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/find-dead-airpods/): 電池切れのAirPodsはリアルタイムでは追跡できません。それでも効果のある3つの方法：「探す」の最後の位置、残り電力での再スキャン、見つかりやすい場所の確認。
- [Bluetoothヘッドホンの探し方](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/find-lost-bluetooth-headphones/): ソニー、Bose、JBL、Beatsのヘッドホンのほとんどは「探す」非対応。電源が入っていれば、iPhoneでBluetooth信号の強さをたどって見つけられます。
- [ワイヤレスイヤホンの見つけ方](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/find-lost-earbuds/): ワイヤレスイヤホンを片方無くした・落とした時の見つけ方。Anker、ソニー、AVIOT、JBL、Galaxy Budsも、電源が入っていればiPhoneの無料アプリで信号をたどって探せます。
- [スマートウォッチの探し方](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/find-lost-smartwatch/): スマートウォッチやスマートバンドをなくした？Fitbit、Garmin、Xiaomi Smart Band、Apple Watchは常にBluetooth信号を出しているので、iPhoneで信号をたどって見つけられます。
- [Bluetoothスピーカーの探し方](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/find-lost-bluetooth-speaker/): JBL、Bose、ソニー、AnkerのBluetoothスピーカーが見つからない？電源が入っていれば、強い信号をiPhoneでたどって探せます。
- [近くのBluetooth機器を探す](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/bluetooth-scanner-iphone/): iPhoneで近くのBluetooth機器を探す方法。設定アプリでは分からない機器の場所を、Bluetoothスキャナーアプリで信号強度・メーカー・モデルつきで一覧表示し、近づいて探せます。
- [AirPodsケースの探し方](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/jp/guides/find-lost-airpods-case/): AirPodsの充電ケースだけなくした？ふたを閉じたケースは信号を出しません。探せる場合・探せない場合と、どちらでもできることを正直に解説します。
## 가이드 (ko)
- [가이드](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/): 잃어버린 에어팟, 무선 이어폰(한쪽만이라도), 헤드폰, 스마트워치, 블루투스 스피커를 찾는 방법을 상황별로 정리했습니다. 나의 찾기가 없어도 iPhone으로 찾을 수 있습니다.
- [에어팟 잃어버렸을 때 찾는법](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/how-to-find-lost-airpods/): 에어팟이 안 보이면 먼저 나의 찾기에서 사운드를 재생하세요. 지도가 너무 대략적이거나 등록하지 않았다면 iPhone으로 블루투스 신호를 따라가 손이 닿는 곳까지 찾을 수 있습니다.
- [나의 찾기 없이 에어팟 찾기](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/find-airpods-without-find-my/): 나의 찾기를 안 켰거나, iCloud가 없거나, 중고 에어팟인가요? 에어팟은 전원이 켜져 있는 동안 블루투스 신호를 보냅니다. iPhone으로 그 신호를 따라가는 방법을 알려 드립니다.
- [에어팟 한쪽 찾기](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/find-one-lost-airpod/): 에어팟 한쪽이 없어졌나요? 이어폰은 충전되어 있는 동안 한쪽씩 따로 블루투스 신호를 보냅니다. iPhone의 핫·콜드 안내로 잃어버린 한쪽을 찾는 방법을 단계별로 설명합니다.
- [꺼진 에어팟 찾기](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/find-dead-airpods/): 방전된 에어팟은 신호를 멈추기 때문에 어떤 앱도 실시간으로 추적할 수 없습니다. 방전 여부 확인법, 나의 찾기의 마지막 위치 활용법, 다시 신호가 잡히는 순간 찾는 방법을 정리했습니다.
- [블루투스 헤드폰 찾기](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/find-lost-bluetooth-headphones/): 소니, 보스, 비츠, JBL 헤드폰을 잃어버렸나요? 전원이 켜져 있다면 iPhone으로 블루투스 신호를 따라가세요. 꺼져 있다면 수색 범위를 좁히고 다시 켜지는 순간 잡는 방법을 알려 드립니다.
- [블루투스 이어폰 찾기](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/find-lost-earbuds/): 무선 이어폰을 잃어버렸나요? 케이스 밖에서 전원이 켜져 있으면 어떤 브랜드든 블루투스 신호를 보냅니다. iPhone으로 그 신호를 따라가 찾는 방법을 전부 정리했습니다.
- [스마트워치 찾기](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/find-lost-smartwatch/): 미밴드, 핏빗, 가민 등 많은 스마트워치와 밴드는 소리를 내거나 지도를 보여 주지 못합니다. 대신 iPhone으로 블루투스 신호를 따라가 찾는 방법을 단계별로 설명합니다.
- [블루투스 스피커 찾기](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/find-lost-bluetooth-speaker/): 가능합니다. JBL, 보스, 앤커 스피커가 켜져 있고 약 30미터 안에 있다면 iPhone으로 블루투스 신호를 따라가 바로 찾을 수 있습니다. 꺼져 있을 때의 대처법도 알려 드립니다.
- [주변 블루투스 기기 검색](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/bluetooth-scanner-iphone/): iPhone 설정은 페어링된 기기만 보여 줍니다. 블루투스 스캐너 앱을 쓰면 주변의 모든 기기를 신호 강도, 제조사, 모델과 함께 볼 수 있습니다. 사용법을 알려 드립니다.
- [에어팟 케이스 찾기](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/ko/guides/find-lost-airpods-case/): 이어폰이 든 채 뚜껑이 닫힌 에어팟 케이스는 블루투스 신호를 보내지 않습니다. 잃어버린 케이스를 찾을 수 있는 경우, 찾는 방법, 모델별 나의 찾기 지원을 정리했습니다.

- [Bul olmadan AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/tr/rehberler/bul-olmadan-airpods-bulma/): Bul hiç açılmadı, ikinci el AirPods ya da iCloud erişimi yok mu? AirPods'u iPhone ile Bluetooth sinyalinden adım adım bulun.
- [AirPods'un tek tarafı](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/tr/rehberler/airpods-tek-tarafi-kayboldu/): AirPods'un tek tarafını mı kaybettiniz? Her kulaklık kendi Bluetooth sinyalini yayar. Sağ veya sol AirPods'u iPhone ile adım adım bulun.
- [Şarjı biten AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/tr/rehberler/sarji-biten-airpods-bulma/): Pili bitmiş AirPods veya kulaklık mı kayboldu? Canlı olarak bulunamaz. İşe yarayanlar: son konum, tekrar tarama ve akıllı arama.
- [Kaybolan Bluetooth kulaklık](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/tr/rehberler/kaybolan-bluetooth-kulaklik-bulma/): Kulaklık bul: Sony, JBL, Bose veya Beats Bluetooth kulaklığınızı iPhone ile Bluetooth sinyalinden bulun – Bul uygulamasında olmasa bile.
- [Kablosuz kulaklık](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/tr/rehberler/kablosuz-kulaklik-bulma/): Galaxy Buds, Xiaomi, JBL veya AirPods kablosuz kulaklığınız mı kayboldu? iPhone ile Bluetooth sinyalinden bulun – her marka için tek yöntem.
- [Akıllı saat](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/tr/rehberler/akilli-saat-bulma/): Akıllı saatiniz, Mi Band, Huawei veya Garmin mi kayboldu? Evde, arabada ya da spor çantasında iPhone ile Bluetooth sinyalinden bulun.
- [Bluetooth hoparlör](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/tr/rehberler/bluetooth-hoparlor-bulma/): JBL hoparlör bulunabilir mi? Açıksa evet. Kaybolan Bluetooth hoparlörü iPhone ile sinyal gücünden adım adım bulun.
- [Bluetooth tarayıcı](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/tr/rehberler/bluetooth-tarayici-iphone/): iPhone için Bluetooth tarayıcı: yakındaki tüm Bluetooth cihazlarını sinyal gücü, üretici ve modelle görün ve aradığınızı bulun.
- [AirPods kutusu](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/tr/rehberler/airpods-kutusu-bulma/): AirPods kutusunu mu kaybettiniz? Ne zaman bulunabilir, ne zaman bulunamaz ve ne yapmalı – Bul uygulaması ve iPhone'da Bluetooth tarayıcıyla.
## Інструкції (uk)
- [Інструкції](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/): Покрокові інструкції: як з iPhone знайти загублені AirPods, бездротові й повнорозмірні навушники, смарт-годинники та колонки — зокрема пристрої не з «Локатора».
- [Як знайти AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/yak-znajty-airpods/): Загубили AirPods? Перегляньте геопозицію в «Локаторі», а потім ідіть за живим Bluetooth-сигналом, доки не знайдете їх, — навіть зовсім без «Локатора».
- [AirPods без «Локатора»](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/znajty-airpods-bez-lokatora/): «Локатор» не вмикали, AirPods куплені з рук або немає доступу до iCloud? Ось як знайти AirPods з iPhone за Bluetooth-сигналом — покроково.
- [Один навушник AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/zagubyv-odyn-navushnyk-airpods/): Загубили один навушник AirPods? Кожен навушник передає свій Bluetooth-сигнал. Ось як знайти лівий або правий AirPods з iPhone — покроково.
- [Розряджені AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/znajty-rozryadzheni-airpods/): Загубили AirPods чи навушники з розрядженою батареєю? У реальному часі — ніяк. Що працює: остання геопозиція, повторне сканування і розумний пошук.
- [Навушники по Bluetooth](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/znajty-navushnyky-po-bluetooth/): Як знайти навушники: шукайте загублені бездротові навушники Sony, JBL, Bose чи Beats з iPhone за Bluetooth-сигналом — навіть якщо їх немає в «Локаторі».
- [TWS-навушники](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/znajty-tws-navushnyky/): Загубили бездротові навушники Galaxy Buds, Redmi Buds, JBL чи AirPods? Ось як знайти їх з iPhone за Bluetooth-сигналом — один спосіб для будь-якого бренду.
- [Смарт-годинник](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/znajty-smart-godynnyk/): Загубили смарт-годинник, Mi Band, Amazfit чи Galaxy Watch? Ось як знайти їх з iPhone удома, в машині чи в спортивній сумці за Bluetooth-сигналом.
- [Як знайти колонку JBL](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/yak-znajty-kolonku-jbl/): Як знайти колонку JBL, якщо вона вимкнена? Чесна відповідь — і як швидко знайти ввімкнену Bluetooth-колонку з iPhone за силою сигналу.
- [Сканер Bluetooth](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/skaner-bluetooth-iphone/): Сканер Bluetooth для iPhone: усі Bluetooth-пристрої поруч із силою сигналу, виробником і моделлю. Як дізнатися назву навушників і знайти потрібний пристрій.
- [Футляр AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/uk/instrukciyi/znajty-futlyar-airpods/): Загубили футляр (кейс) AirPods? Коли його можна знайти, коли ні і що робити — з «Локатором» і Bluetooth-сканером на iPhone.
## Hướng dẫn (vi)
- [Hướng dẫn](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/): Hướng dẫn từng bước tìm AirPods, tai nghe không dây và chụp tai, đồng hồ thông minh và loa bị mất bằng iPhone – kể cả thiết bị không có trong ứng dụng Tìm.
- [AirPods bị mất](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/cach-tim-airpods-bi-mat/): Mất AirPods? Xem vị trí trong ứng dụng Tìm, rồi đi theo tín hiệu Bluetooth theo thời gian thực cho đến khi cầm được chúng – kể cả khi không có Tìm.
- [AirPods không cần Tìm](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/tim-airpods-khong-can-ung-dung-tim/): Chưa từng bật Tìm, AirPods mua lại hay không vào được iCloud? Đây là cách tìm AirPods bằng iPhone qua tín hiệu Bluetooth, từng bước một.
- [Mất 1 bên AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/mat-mot-ben-tai-nghe-airpods/): Mất 1 bên tai nghe AirPods? Mỗi bên phát tín hiệu Bluetooth riêng. Đây là cách tìm tai nghe bên trái hoặc bên phải bằng iPhone, từng bước.
- [AirPods hết pin](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/tim-airpods-het-pin/): Mất AirPods hay tai nghe khi đã hết pin? Không thể tìm theo thời gian thực. Điều thực sự hiệu quả: vị trí cuối cùng, quét lại và tìm có phương pháp.
- [Tai nghe Bluetooth bị mất](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/cach-tim-tai-nghe-bluetooth-bi-mat/): Cách tìm tai nghe Bluetooth bị mất bằng iPhone: lần theo tín hiệu Bluetooth của tai nghe Sony, JBL, Bose hay Beats – kể cả khi không có trong ứng dụng Tìm.
- [Tai nghe không dây](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/tim-tai-nghe-khong-day-bi-mat/): Mất tai nghe không dây Galaxy Buds, Xiaomi, JBL hay AirPods? Đây là cách tìm bằng iPhone qua tín hiệu Bluetooth – một cách cho mọi hãng.
- [Đồng hồ thông minh](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/tim-dong-ho-thong-minh-bi-mat/): Mất đồng hồ thông minh, Mi Band, Huawei hay Garmin? Đây là cách tìm bằng iPhone trong nhà, trên xe hoặc trong túi tập gym qua tín hiệu Bluetooth.
- [Loa Bluetooth bị mất](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/tim-loa-bluetooth-bi-mat/): Có tìm được loa JBL không? Có, nếu loa còn bật. Đây là cách tìm loa Bluetooth bị mất bằng iPhone qua cường độ tín hiệu, từng bước.
- [Quét Bluetooth](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/quet-bluetooth-iphone/): Quét Bluetooth trên iPhone: xem mọi thiết bị Bluetooth ở gần kèm cường độ tín hiệu, nhà sản xuất và kiểu máy – rồi tìm thiết bị bạn cần.
- [Hộp sạc AirPods](https://bluetoothfinderapp.com/vi/huong-dan/tim-hop-sac-airpods-bi-mat/): Mất hộp sạc AirPods? Khi nào tìm được, khi nào không và nên làm gì – với ứng dụng Tìm và ứng dụng quét Bluetooth trên iPhone.
## Key facts
- Product type: iOS app to find lost or nearby Bluetooth devices (e.g. AirPods, smartwatches, headphones)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6756609274 (id 6756609274)
- 6 in-page feature highlights (scan, hot & cold, proximity %, device details, and more)
- OS: Requires iOS 17.1 or later
- App size: 24.2 MB
- Age rating: 4+
- Software version: 1.4.2
- Supported page languages: 16
- Last build date: 2026-10-14
## How it works
1. Install from the App Store and allow Bluetooth when prompted.
2. Scan for devices and pick the one you are looking for.
3. Move using hot & cold cues and the proximity percentage until you are next to the device.
